title: Responses API now ties GPT-6.2 reasoning items to earlier conversation history
summary:
Agents using GPT-6.2 in the Responses API can build on earlier reasoning to deliver better results with fewer tokens and more cache hits.

Starting with our newest frontier models, each reasoning item is now tied to the conversation history before it, so editing earlier messages causes the API to dr
text:
Agents using GPT-6.2 in the Responses API can build on earlier reasoning to deliver better results with fewer tokens and more cache hits.

Starting with our newest frontier models, each reasoning item is now tied to the conversation history before it, so editing earlier messages causes the API to drop reasoning that follows the change.

title: Gemini app for Mac now has computer use to hand off tasks across apps and the web
summary:
With computer use in the Gemini app for Mac, you can now hand off tasks across your folders, apps, and the web, while your screen and cursor stay yours.

Watch Gemini click, scroll, and type in a live background window, turning a quick sketch into a rigged 3D model in Blender.

title: OpenAI built Performance Factory to coordinate agents investigating ChatGPT regressions
summary:
Codex already helps us build ChatGPT faster. Now it’s helping us keep ChatGPT fast.

We built the Performance Factory to coordinate agents that investigate regressions, propose fixes for engineers to review, and check if those fixes work in production.

title: Perplexity Computer Brain now auto-creates self-improving agent skills
summary:
Computer's personalized self-improvement agent, Brain, now automatically creates self-improving agent skills for you.

Brain learns how you work from past sessions and memory, then writes and updates personalized skills for future tasks.
